profile: Independent diagnosis of actual WDA startup failure and review of the bounded next configuration
tier: Recorded CI artifacts, primary documentation and offline inventory analysis only
verdictScope: The actual reviewed CI run failed before Safari checks. This verdict does not reject the proposed next experiment or claim a confirmed compiler defect.
scoreMeaning: Unscored schema placeholder; no game-quality score was measured.
blindComparison: No blind comparison was conducted. Source provenance was known; no product/reference preference was evaluated. The earlier headless bootstrap improvement is an actual log observation, not an element-level achievement.
conclusion: The headless change removed the recorded visible-UI restart and execution reached WDA. The next failure is WDA readiness/session creation, with zero Safari/game checks. The available logs do not establish why WDA never became reachable. SDK-aligned runtime selection, visible Xcode output and a finite 240000 ms WDA wait form a reasonable next combined trial, whose outcome must be measured.

observations.detail: isHeadless=true was sent and recognized. The driver logged an already-booted headless simulator and simStarted; the prior visible-window restart messages are absent.
Xcode16.4 launched xcodebuild with IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=26.2 twice. This establishes the invocation, not a compiler failure.

The first start announces a 60000 ms readiness wait. All 120 recorded initial status polls fail. Appium reports the readiness timeout and explicitly shuts down xcodebuild; the recorded xcodebuild exit is null/SIGTERM, after that shutdown.
First wait announcement 2026-09-14T12:54:08.721+09:00 to timeout 12:56:12.626+09:00 spans 123.905 seconds. Configured/reported 60000 ms is not the measured elapsed duration.

The second wait announcement is followed by wdaSessionAttempted after 7 ms and wdaSessionFailed after 121 ms. This is not a second observed complete 60-second readiness trial; why it advances immediately is unresolved.
The final POST /session returns HTTP500; report.status is failed, checks is empty and device is null. The game validation path never starts.

The stored inventory contains available SE3 devices for18.5,18.6,26.0,26.1,26.2. If the active simulator SDK is measured as18.5, matching numeric major/minor selects the18.5 device22A3039C-6A45-47F4-82D4-80C58CA94379 uniquely. The failed run did not save its active simulator SDK output, so18.5 here is an explicit official-table assumption.

rejectedCausalClaims.claim: SDK18.5 versus deployment target26.2 proves this was a compiler failure.
rejectedCausalClaims.reason: No autonomous compiler error or numeric failure exit is recorded. Apple defines the Deployment Target table column as App Store Connect upload support and separately lists Simulator support. The mismatch is a relevant condition to control, not a diagnosed compiler result.

rejectedCausalClaims.claim: The task failed because xcodebuild exited by itself.
rejectedCausalClaims.reason: The visible exit follows Appium timeout and explicit shutdown. This does not exclude a hidden build problem, but it does refute treating this SIGTERM as its proof.

rejectedCausalClaims.claim: Only60 actual seconds were allowed and240000 will necessarily cure the problem.
rejectedCausalClaims.reason: The initial observed span is123.905 seconds and no later healthy WDA response exists. A cold build, hang, runtime interaction or other condition remains possible.

rejectedCausalClaims.claim: The prior headless repair has not worked.
rejectedCausalClaims.reason: The precise old failure path disappears in this run, and simStarted/WDA initialization are observed. Overall Safari success remains absent.

proposedScope.purpose: Reveal build/test progress or diagnostics that the current log filters out.
proposedScope.verification: Retain the next actual Appium/Xcode output, command and process exit or readiness outcome.

proposedScope.change: Use appium:wdaLaunchTimeout=240000 while keeping finite job/retry limits.
proposedScope.purpose: Allow a bounded longer first startup and observe whether WDA becomes ready.
proposedScope.status: Reasonable recovery experiment; no proof that insufficient wait caused this failure.
proposedScope.verification: Record the accepted capability and actual wait/readiness timestamps. Do not describe its configured value as an exact wall-clock bound.

proposedScope.change: Read the active iphonesimulator SDK and choose an available SE3 runtime with the same numeric major/minor.
proposedScope.purpose: Remove the automatic latest-runtime selection from a controlled WDA startup trial.
proposedScope.status: Reasonable environment alignment; not a proven mandatory compiler repair.
proposedScope.verification: Save active Xcode path, xcrun --sdk iphonesimulator --show-sdk-version output, selected runtime.version and UDID. If no match exists, report the actual available choices and fail explicitly instead of silently selecting latest.

proposedScope.change: Keep the runtime selection consistent in mobile-simulator.yml and the existing identical pages.yml path.
proposedScope.purpose: Avoid the same helper later using a different unexamined runtime policy.
proposedScope.status: Implementation scope recommendation when applying the selector; no workflow/product file was edited by this reviewer.
proposedScope.verification: Use the runtime inventory version rather than reconstructing it from the identifier; the stored iOS-26-0 identifier has version26.0.1.

attribution: Testing these bounded changes together is acceptable to reach a usable validation environment. If the next run succeeds, it establishes the combined configuration; it does not isolate which change was necessary. Extra factorial retries solely to assign credit are not required.

officialSources.paraphrase: Xcode16.4 includes iOS SDK18.5. Its Deployment Target row lists iOS15–18, whose legend concerns App Store Connect uploads. The separate Simulator column lists iOS15 or later.
wdaLaunchTimeout waits for WDA responsiveness and defaults to60000 ms. showXcodeLog controls Xcode output and defaults to false.

findings.problem: The actual Mobile Safari run performed zero browser checks because no usable WDA session was established after Simulator boot.
findings.why: The intended iOS/Safari validation cannot evaluate any game behavior while session creation fails; the headless bootstrap improvement alone does not supply that evidence.
findings.fix: In the next authorized CI, preserve SDK/runtime selection and full Xcode diagnostics, apply a finite readiness wait, and reach WDA plus actual Safari checks. Inspect test-results/ios-safari/report.json: checks.length must exceed0; an overall pass additionally requires status=passed. Preserve any failure and its exact build.
findings.hypothesis: WDA unavailability is observed; its root cause is not established. The SDK-aligned, logged240000 ms trial is supported as a next diagnostic/recovery step, not a guaranteed fix.
evidence: ci-ios-3aa5e4f/appium.log:headless simStarted followed by refused WDA status
findings.refutation: The separate reviewer confirmed this symptom and rejected unsupported compiler and exact60-second causal claims.

limitations: This is analysis of an actual failed run and a proposed next configuration, not a review of an implemented new selector or proof of startup under it.
No browser, local server, Simulator, xcodebuild or Appium process was launched; no product, workflow, raw log or earlier review file was edited.
The absence of compiler diagnostics in a filtered log does not prove a healthy build.
No source-level explanation of the unusual wait/retry timing is established.
All actual game/reference comparisons and physical-phone properties remain outside this review.
